common.actionFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Collaborators and store admins sign in here.
login.created: Account created. You can sign in now.
login.linked: Linked to your existing account. Sign in with your existing password.
login.noAccess: This account has no portal access. Ask the store admin for an invite.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

accept.title: Accept your invitation
accept.intro: Choose a password to create your account. If you already have an account with this email (for example a shopper account), enter your existing password and the portal access will be added to it.
accept.missingToken: This invite link is missing its token. Open the link from your email.

stores.title: Choose a store
stores.empty: You are not a collaborator of any store yet. Ask a store admin for an invite.

products.title: Products
products.empty: No products are available in this store yet.
products.potential: Profit if sold at the suggested price: {amount}
products.priceHelp: Your profit = your selling price − the original price.

requests.title: My requests
requests.created: Request sent. The store admin has been notified.
requests.empty: No requests yet. Pick a product to create one.

newRequest.title: Create request
newRequest.sellingPriceHint: Must be at least the original price. Your profit is the difference × quantity. The suggested price is only a guide.
newRequest.proofHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB. The deposit due is shown after you submit.

earnings.title: Profit
earnings.empty: Profit appears here once a customer pays.

admin.title: Store admin
admin.settingsNote: Deposit % and the default contact email are set by the platform admin in Medusa admin. Default contact: {contact}.

review.title: Request: {product}
review.approveText: Creates the customer's payment link at the collaborator's price and emails it to the collaborator and the customer. Check the deposit proof first.
review.approvedWait: Approved. Waiting for the customer to pay. The link was emailed if an email provider is set up; you can also copy it here and send it yourself.
review.reverseText: Cancelled orders reverse automatically. After a refund, reverse the collaborator's profit here. A negative ledger entry is added; if already paid out it nets off the next payout.

collabs.title: Collaborators
collabs.inviteCreated: Invite created. If the email does not arrive, share this link with them:
collabs.name: Name
collabs.deleteText: {email} will be removed from your store together with their requests. This cannot be undone. Collaborators with earnings or payouts cannot be deleted; revoke them instead.

adminProducts.title: Products
adminProducts.subtitle: Create and manage what your store sells. Changes to the suggested price update the shop.
adminProducts.emptyHint: Create your first product to start working with collaborators.
adminProducts.deleteText: “{title}” will be removed from the shop. This cannot be undone.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.carried: Carried over to next month (net not positive)
payouts.monthEndText: Creates one payout per collaborator for everything owed, net of refunds. Transfer the money yourself, then mark each payout as paid.

pay.title: Your order
pay.notFoundText: Check the link in your email or contact the person who sent it.
pay.depositConfirmed: Your deposit of {amount} has been confirmed.
pay.paid: This order has been paid. Thank you!

errors.notCollaborator: You are not a collaborator of this store.
errors.priceTooLow: Your selling price cannot be lower than the original price.
errors.productUnavailable: This product is not available in this store.
errors.noPrice: This product has no price in the store currency.
errors.alreadyReviewed: This request has already been reviewed.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired.
errors.accountExists: An account with this email already exists. Enter its existing password to link it.
errors.fileSize: The file must be between 1 byte and 5 MB.
errors.collabNotFound: Collaborator not found in this store.
errors.payoutPaid: This payout is already marked paid.
errors.adminElsewhere: This email is already a portal admin of another store.
errors.originalTooHigh: The original price cannot be higher than the suggested price.
errors.costTooHigh: The original cost cannot be higher than the original price.
errors.openRequests: This product has open collaborator requests. Resolve them before deleting it.
errors.categoryShared: This category is shared and can only be changed by the platform admin.
errors.noStockLocation: This store has no stock location, so stock cannot be tracked.
errors.productNotFound: Product not found in this store.
errors.variantNotFound: Variant not found on this product.
errors.skuTaken: This SKU is already used by another product.
errors.collabHasHistory: This collaborator has earnings or payouts and cannot be deleted. Revoke their access instead.
errors.pageFailedHint: This page could not be loaded. Try again, or go back to the start.
errors.notFoundHint: The item you are looking for does not exist or you do not have access to it.

productForm.name: Product name
productForm.handleHint: Used in the product link. Leave empty to generate it from the name.
productForm.publishedHint: Published products are visible in the shop. Drafts are hidden.
productForm.noCategories: No categories yet. Create one in Categories first.
productForm.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB each. The first image is the main image.
productForm.imageChange: Choose a new image to replace it
productForm.pricingIntro: Every product has three prices. Only the cost is private.
productForm.suggestedHint: The price in your shop. Changing it updates the shop. Collaborators see it as a guide.
productForm.originalHint: What collaborators pay you. Their profit = selling price − original price. Empty means the same as the suggested price.
productForm.previewCollab: Collaborator profit per unit at the suggested price: {amount}
productForm.previewStore: Your margin per unit (original price − cost): {amount}
productForm.previewInvalid: The prices must satisfy: cost ≤ original price ≤ suggested price.
productForm.stockHint: Leave empty to not track stock.
productForm.skuHint: Leave empty to generate one automatically.
productForm.dangerText: Deleting a product removes it from the shop for good.
productForm.mediaHint: Collaborators see all of this on the product page and can download it.
productForm.videoHint: MP4 or WebM, up to 20 MB. Shown first on the product page.
productForm.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Reload the page and sign in again.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Group your products. Categories are shared across stores: you can use any, but only edit your own.
categories.emptyHint: Create a category to organise your products.
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteText: “{name}” will be deleted. Products stay, but lose this category.
categories.sharedHint: Shared categories are managed by the platform admin. You can still assign them to your products.

appearance.title: Storefront editor
appearance.subtitle: Choose a theme, add your logo and branding, edit the home page and any storefront text. Save a draft and preview the real pages before you publish.
appearance.templatesHint: A theme sets the whole structure of your shop: header, home page, listing and product pages, footer, plus colors and type.
appearance.themeResets: Switching theme changes the structure (header, footer and listing layouts, home section order and styles). Everything you wrote is kept: logo, texts, accent color, footer, announcement and the text, images and links in your sections.
appearance.primaryHint: Used for buttons and highlights across the shop.
appearance.brandingHint: Your logo and the name and tagline customers see.
appearance.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB. A transparent PNG works best. It replaces the text name in the header.
appearance.showName: Show the store name next to the logo
appearance.storeNameHint: Shown in the header, footer and checkout. Leave empty to keep the current name.
appearance.taglineHint: The short line under your name on the home page and in Google results.
appearance.faviconHint: A small square PNG or ICO.
appearance.homeHint: Turn sections on or off, change their order and edit what they say. Open a section to edit it.
appearance.noSettings: This section has no settings. You can still turn it on or off and move it.
appearance.linkHint: A path in your shop like /store, or a full https:// link.
appearance.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB.
appearance.announcementHint: A thin bar above the header for shipping offers or notices.
appearance.footerHint: The footer layout comes from the theme. Here you edit what it says.
appearance.contactHint: Phone and email become tap-to-call / tap-to-write links automatically. An address is shown as text; add a Google Maps link if you want it clickable.
appearance.textsHint: Change the wording of headings and buttons across your shop. The grey placeholder is the current text; leave a box empty to keep it.
appearance.previewNote: A quick sketch of unsaved changes. Use Live to see the real pages.
appearance.saveHint: Changes appear on your storefront within a few seconds.
appearance.statusLive: You are editing what is live. Changes are saved as a draft automatically.
appearance.liveNeedsDraft: Save a draft to see your real pages here.
appearance.noProductForPreview: Add a product to preview the product page.
appearance.liveNote: The real storefront at true device width. It updates a moment after each edit; nothing is published until you press Publish.
appearance.savedDraft: Draft saved. Visitors still see the published storefront.
appearance.discarded: Draft discarded. You are editing the live version again.
appearance.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Reload the page and sign in again.

contactPlaceholders.address: 12 Nguyen Trai, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City

contactLinkPlaceholders.phone: Optional: leave empty to use the number
contactLinkPlaceholders.email: Optional: leave empty to use the email
contactLinkPlaceholders.zalo: Optional: leave empty to use the number

appearance.widgetHint: Floating buttons so shoppers can call or chat with you in one tap.
appearance.widgetZaloHint: Zalo: a phone number or a zalo.me link. Leave a field empty to hide that button.
appearance.widgetVnOnly: Only show to shoppers in Vietnam
